title: All-hands Aug 2026 - talking points & Q&A (draft)
content:
All-hands — August 2026
Draft talking points + Q&A / notes to self
Owner: Rachel Chen (people ops) — collab with Samira, Lucas, Noah
Status: draft — want leadership review by Mon 2026-08-03 EOD

Goals for this all-hands
- Align org on priorities for H2 2026 (reliability + scale + go-to-market motions)
- Share product milestones: Redwood Private GA timeline, Dedicated performance improvements, new Optimize features
- Surface hiring and org changes + where to focus energy
- Keep tone optimistic but realistic — acknowledge areas we missed and signal concrete next steps

Agenda (30–40m + Q&A)
1) Quick company state (5m) — top-line metrics + what's changed since last all-hands
2) Product highlights (8–10m) — shipping/roadmap items customers care about
3) Operations & reliability update (5m) — latency/uptime, SRE workstreams
4) GTM and growth (5m) — funnels, PLG engagement, enterprise traction
5) People & org (3–5m) — hiring, promotions, new managers
6) Live Q&A (10–15m)

Key talking points — Company state
- Revenue momentum: healthy QoQ growth driven by mid-market and a few larger Dedicated commitments. Don’t share exact numbers in this doc (ops will confirm the topline).
- Customer signals: more customers using Private for regulated workloads — pipeline in EMEA is growing. Good product-market fit signals for Private.
- Headline: We’re in a stronger position on reliability and predictability than 6 months ago but still have work to do on cost per token for some workloads.

Product highlights (stories to tell)
- Redwood Private: GA approach + pilot feedback\  - Pilot customers (2) reported successful on-prem installs and KMS integration; some requests for better install docs and automated health checks.\  - GA target: mid-September 2026 (subject to engineering signoff). Messaging: "Private is production-ready for regulated customers; we’ll continue to iterate on install/ops experience."
- Redwood Dedicated improvements\  - Improved scheduling + autoscaling policies reduced tail latency by ~15% in internal benchmarks (call out that numbers are internal).\  - Next: burst capacity options and better tooling for reserved pool sizing.
- Redwood Optimize updates\  - New quantization recommendations UI in console preview; early internal tests show 20–30% cost reduction for typical chat workloads.
  - Plan: beta to selected customers in September.
- Hosted API / model catalog\  - Added two new curated open models with Redwood-verified profiles; improved streaming stability.\  - Ongoing work: model fallback policies to reduce outage risk when a model variant has issues.

Operations & reliability
- Recent incidents: brief recap of July incident (short summary) and what we changed — improved tracing on routing layer, adjusted autoscaler thresholds, and added a canary rollout for kernel selection changes.
- SLA work: progress on SLOs for Dedicated customers; some remaining work on multi-region failover.

GTM highlights
- PLG health: activation metrics up modestly after product onboarding tweaks; still lots of upside in developer experience adoption flows (examples: SDK quickstarts, sample apps).
- Enterprise motion: closing two larger Dedicated deals next quarter; need coordinated CS + solutions-engineering support for pilots.

People / org updates
- New hires: welcome 3 in infra, 2 in customer success — quick shoutouts (put names in slides).
- Promotions: internal promotion list to be announced (HR to finalize).
- Org ask: engineering teams — please prioritize a short one-pager for any customer-facing feature we mention on stage so CS can reference it.

Anticipated Q&A (with suggested responses)
Q: When exactly is Redwood Private GA?
A: We’re targeting mid-September 2026 for GA. Still dependent on finishing install automation and a final round of pilot validation; we’ll give a locked date after engineering signoff next week.

Q: Any change to pricing for Dedicated or Hosted?
A: No pricing changes to announce at this all-hands. We’re working on better tooling to reduce customers’ per-token cost (Optimize + batching improvements).

Q: What happened in the July outage and how are we preventing recurrence?
A: Short answer: a routing kernel selection change created a rare mismatch under a specific sequence-length distribution. Fixes: rollback, better canary rollout, added tracing + automated alerting for kernel mismatches. We’ve run additional load tests and applied a temporary guardrail in the scheduler. Longer-term: improving test coverage for kernel selection logic.

Q: Any layoffs or hiring freezes?
A: No layoffs. We’ve been thoughtful about hiring — prioritizing roles that unblock revenue and platform reliability. Hiring continues in key areas; some teams may pause new reqs while they shift priorities.

Q: How do we measure success for H2?
A: Mix of reliability (SLOs), GTM motion (PLG activation + enterprise closed deals), and unit economics (cost/token improvements via Optimize). We’ll share a short H2 scoreboard in the follow-up email.

Logistics + next steps
- Slides: Samira owning deck — Rachel to review by Mon 8/03. Need 2–3 customer quotes for Private slide — CS to provide.
- Rehearsal: Wed 8/05 10:30am PT (30m) — leadership only; full run Wed 8/05 4pm PT.
- Pre-comms: short email + TL;DR from CEO same day. People ops to draft and send the follow-up with scoreboard and links.

Notes to self / TODOs
- Add customer quote placeholders and change to real names once approved.
- Confirm pilot results and add a bullet about install doc improvements.
- Get SRE one-pager on July incident root cause and mitigation.

Rough slide mapping (for Samira)
- Slide 1: Title + TL;DR (3 bullets)
- Slide 2: Company state & topline bullets
- Slide 3: Product highlights (Private, Dedicated, Optimize) with 1-sentence callouts
- Slide 4: Reliability update + short incident recap
- Slide 5: GTM highlights + enterprise wins
- Slide 6: People & org notes + shoutouts
- Slide 7: Q&A prompt + how to submit questions ahead of time

Unresolved questions (need answers before finalizing)
- Exact topline revenue metric to share (ops/finance)
- Locked GA date for Private (engineering)
- Final list of names for promotions (people ops)
